findings.invariant_violated: continuous chain of custody / no spontaneous objects
findings.description: The scene starts with exactly two cubes on an open table. One hand only ever pinches the end cube of the row, yet new solid cubes keep coming out of the cube it holds: at 00:01.0, 00:03.25, 00:04.0, 00:05.0, 00:06.0 and 00:06.75. The row grows from 2 to 8 cubes. No cube enters from off-frame and none is taken from a pile or container. A visibly pinching hand could not hide six cubes, so this is impossible even if the move involved concealed palming.

findings.invariant_violated: object identity persistence (object becomes a different object)
findings.description: Between 00:00.25 and 00:00.75, while the hand twists it in place, cube A's whole body (top cap area and every visible side) changes from solid green to solid blue. It stays the same cube in the same grip with no swap visible.

findings.invariant_violated: object identity persistence (object becomes a different object)
findings.description: At 00:03.5 the held cube is solid green showing '3'. By 00:03.75, still in the same pinch and position, it is a solid peach/orange cube showing '2'. Its body color changed with no visible swap.

findings.description: The held end cube appears blue showing '3' (00:05.25). By 00:05.75 it is green '3', and by 00:06.0 it reads green '5', all in the same grip and position. Its body color changed with no visible swap.
